Holmes Panel & Paint Smash Repairs is seeking a qualified and experienced Panel Beater to join our automotive smash repair workshop in Armadale, Western Australia.

The role requires the ability to complete repairs independently while maintaining high standards of workmanship, productivity and workplace safety.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

The successful applicant will:
•	Inspect damaged vehicles and assess structural and panel damage.
•	Review repair specifications, job cards and insurance instructions to determine repair requirements.
•	Remove damaged panels, trims, bumpers, lights and associated components to gain access to damaged areas.
•	Repair damaged body panels using recognised panel beating techniques including reshaping, shrinking, stretching and pulling.
•	Straighten vehicle bodies, chassis and structural components using mechanical, hydraulic and electronic alignment equipment.
•	Measure vehicle bodies and structural components to ensure repairs meet manufacturer specifications.
•	Remove and replace damaged panels and structural sections using new, recycled or fabricated components where required.
•	Cut, shape and fit replacement sections made from steel, aluminium, fibreglass and plastic materials.
